# slug command — Design

## Problem

Post titles are turned into URL slugs by hand, inconsistently.

## Goals

- A `slugify` function turns a title into a lowercase hyphenated slug.
- Repeated separators collapse to one hyphen.

## Non-goals

- Unicode transliteration.

## Constraints

- No dependencies.

## Approach

One exported function in `src/slugify.js`, with unit tests.

## Testing

Unit tests only.

## Open questions

None.

# log rotation — Design

## Problem

The service writes one log file that grows without bound.

## Goals

- Rotate the log when it exceeds a configured size.
- Keep a bounded number of rotated files and delete the oldest.
- Rotation never loses a line that was mid-write.

## Non-goals

- Compression of rotated files.
- Shipping logs off the host.

## Constraints

- No dependencies.
- Must work on a file opened in append mode by another process.

## Approach

A `rotate` function in `src/logrotate.js`, called from the existing write path.

## Testing

Unit tests, plus one test that writes concurrently during a rotation.

## Open questions

None.
